At opening, policy on handler training
Everyone on the desk should know the main rule first, then the reasons
Companion Animal Travel Desk handler training and service control

This section sets the standard for safe, steady handling of companion animal bookings and desk-side checks. Staff must be ready to confirm the animal type, review travel papers, and guide passengers through service steps without delay or confusion.

All desk staff must complete approved handler training before they work an animal request alone. Training covers calm contact, carrier checks, record entry, and escalation when a case falls outside routine service. The desk should keep the same clear language for every traveler so that instructions stay consistent and easy to follow. When a passenger brings a reptile, the fee entry must be handled through the required desk process. <<FACT F060>> Staff must place the entry in the service ledger and continue with the booking in a steady manner. No one should improvise charges, waive required steps, or promise a service outcome before the record is complete.

Aurelia Skyways expects the desk to protect the animal, the passenger, and the flight schedule. Handlers must look for signs that an animal is distressed, unsecured, or not fit for travel, and they must report concerns at once. If the situation is routine, proceed with the standard review and confirm that the passenger understands the boarding plan. If the situation is not routine, stop the process and bring in the senior coordinator. The desk should keep the conversation brief, factual, and respectful, with no casual assurances that could create later dispute. Staff must also keep the area orderly, since delays at the counter affect boarding flow and the welcome team.

Records must be complete, readable, and entered as soon as the desk action is finished. Any service change, hold, refusal, or special note must be written in the ledger before the next case is handled. This keeps the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the rest of Aurelia Skyways operations and supports dependable companion travel across the network.

For questions or escalations, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
